When did the answer need the evidence?

Share of the model's attention on the evidence tokens, full cache, at each step. Shaded: the late window where it is needed.

How much of that evidence is still in memory?

Evidence tokens still cached at each step, per precision. Lines apart = rounding made a difference.

How to read this. Each panel is the same image cut into the model's real visual tokens (one per 28×28 px). All three panels keep the same number of tokens; the only difference is whether the stored keys were rounded. Eviction is counterfactual: we record what each precision would throw away while the model answers from the full cache, so all three see identical inputs. "Evidence" is defined from the model itself: visual tokens it attends to a lot late in the answer but barely early on. Exact object boxes (GQA) replace this in a later phase.
